description: Implemented Codex intelligence suggestions for this workspace.

entries.summary: Codify A1/A2/B1 as permanent self-improve guardrails
entries.proposal_text: Add a repo validator for SKILL frontmatter and heredoc anti-patterns, block Bash Python heredocs on Windows, and keep the session scorer bound to the active launcher.
entries.context_for_other_clis: This came from the 2026-04-22 self-improve run after repeated loader blindness and missing session score telemetry.
entries.why_it_was_implemented: The three issues break discoverability, one-off command reliability, and longitudinal self-observation.
entries.how_it_was_implemented: Added validate-codex-setup.mjs, expanded the self-improve workflow to require it, patched bash-guard.ps1, patched session-scorer.ts for modern transcripts, and wired Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1 to run the scorer after Codex exits.
entries.resilience_summary: The fix uses defense in depth: static validation, runtime blocking, session-end scoring, and local skill deployment.
entries.future_failure_review: Without these guards, a long description can hide a skill again, Windows one-offs can fail silently, and trend analysis goes blind because session-scores.jsonl never appears.
